features.ears: WHEN recovery races a pending action, the lifecycle SHALL follow the reviewed single-commit and reserved-work semantics.
features.positive: The accepted winner commits once and the loser has its specified observable outcome.

features.status: draft implementation clause; not new acceptance milestone

features.positive: Real retained fees, sponsor hold and residual duties match the signed phase contract.
features.refusal: A host rollback result cannot certify a ledger-induced failure.

exit_evidence: Complete success/failure/recovery prefixes and real target phase readback, including retained fees and residual debt.
Use cited Opus S06/S08 and S7 proposals after reanchoring; no new security policy is authored here.

sprints.title: Native history and five private composition operators

Different operator fixtures and private availability observations are disjoint; one expert owns shared composition interfaces.
sprints.deliverable: Actual native verified history and private multiparty composition, with all five retained operators and explicit key/genesis/finalizer and completeness evidence.

interfaces: Sequential, disjoint parallel, shared-state interleaving, atomic synchronization, asynchronous messaging
Private party knowledge and complete composed effects
ownership.shared_owner: One integrator owns shared IR, ABI, module exports, CLI dispatch and Cargo configuration; exact disjoint leaf write sets assigned before implementation.

features.status: draft implementation clause; not new acceptance milestone
features.ears: WHEN a successor is accepted, its history consumer SHALL enforce the reviewed predecessor and genesis relation.
features.positive: A valid genesis-to-successor chain uses its actual native history path.
features.refusal: A reused or incompatible predecessor is refused under Opus-owned scenarios.

features.status: draft implementation clause; not new acceptance milestone
features.ears: WHEN history qualification is reported, it SHALL distinguish host validation from native verified values.
features.positive: The report identifies exactly which predecessor facts the relation consumes.
features.refusal: A host Boolean cannot establish recursive native acceptance.

features.status: draft implementation clause; not new acceptance milestone
features.ears: WHEN an operator composes histories, its observation SHALL preserve the declared full effects and ordering.
features.positive: Sequential and disjoint parallel compositions match independent balances, duties and fees.
features.refusal: An omitted child effect fails complete observation.

features.status: draft implementation clause; not new acceptance milestone
features.ears: WHEN shared-state or atomic composition is used, it SHALL implement the accepted conflict and synchronization semantics.
features.positive: The same admitted shared-state case has its specified serialization or atomic result.
features.refusal: A conflicting combination cannot become an arbitrary successful order.

features.status: draft implementation clause; not new acceptance milestone
features.ears: WHEN private asynchronous composition completes, it SHALL provide the reviewed participant result and completeness observation.
features.positive: Distinct parties obtain their specified complete result under declared availability assumptions.
features.refusal: Missing private inputs or incomplete composition cannot be reported complete.

features.status: draft implementation clause; not new acceptance milestone
features.ears: WHEN successor scope expands to a financial family, its qualification SHALL include that family’s accepted SP07/SP08 semantics.
features.positive: An accepted ACTUS debt rule is included in the relevant successor comparison.
features.refusal: Missing semantic input keeps that successor scope open.

exit_evidence: Retained ZR01–16/MNR01–08 predicates with exact native target evidence; no host proof-object approximation.
Each operator has independent complete financial and privacy/completeness evidence, not one representative example.
external_blockers: Native recursion interface and key compatibility remain unqualified.
Applicable financial semantics and private-party availability evidence are prerequisites.

sprints.title: Federation, solvers and distinct cost planes
deps: D06 target adapters and D07 lifecycle for settlement; applicable D08 verified composition inputs.
Direct execution remains available; optional use does not remove required U5 delivery.
parallel_work: Adapter byte fixtures, cost ledgers, solver normal cases and committee configuration collection can proceed independently.
sprints.deliverable: Exact external adapters, concurrent delegated budgets, payment/result/delivery handling and measured distinct execution/economic cost planes using existing program consumers.

proposed_paths_or_roles: Federation/solver/cost adapters within actual existing crates after interfaces are fixed; Node experiment is not the default native implementation.
interfaces: Exact adapter bytes and typed results
Execution cost, DUST, financial fee, service fee and recovery reserve
ownership.shared_owner: One integrator owns shared IR, ABI, module exports, CLI dispatch and Cargo configuration; exact disjoint leaf write sets assigned before implementation.

features.status: draft implementation clause; not new acceptance milestone
features.ears: WHEN an external result is consumed, the adapter SHALL preserve the reviewed exact byte and identity binding.
features.positive: An X request consumes its specified X response bytes.
features.refusal: An X/Y mismatch is refused under Opus-owned scenarios.

features.status: draft implementation clause; not new acceptance milestone
features.ears: WHEN concurrent delegations consume capacity, their service SHALL enforce the reviewed durable aggregate budget.
features.positive: A budget10 admits concurrent6+4 with the specified results.
features.refusal: Concurrent6+5 is refused under Opus-owned scenarios.

features.status: draft implementation clause; not new acceptance milestone
features.ears: WHEN an epoch ends or a delegation is revoked, its consumer SHALL apply the reviewed lifecycle transition.
features.positive: A current epoch delegation produces its authorized result.
features.refusal: Expired capacity cannot resurrect through replay.

features.status: draft implementation clause; not new acceptance milestone
features.ears: WHEN a service completes paid work, its report SHALL distinguish payment, result availability and delivery.
features.positive: The client receives the specified result with reconciled service payment.
features.refusal: Payment alone cannot be reported as delivered computation.

features.status: draft implementation clause; not new acceptance milestone
features.ears: WHEN cost is reported, the consumer SHALL keep logical work, physical work, DUST and each fee/reserve plane distinct.
features.positive: A run reconciles observed columns and labels unmeasured values.
features.refusal: Missing native measurement cannot be represented as zero cost.

features.status: draft implementation clause; not new acceptance milestone
features.ears: WHEN a developer chooses direct execution, the public path SHALL remain available under the declared product contract.
features.positive: The same supported program completes without an optional federation service.

sprints.title: Complete ACTUS semantics and conformance
deps: Preparation starts with D02; accepted relevant semantic inputs feed D08 before successor qualification.
Full qualification consumes D03/D06 and applicable D07/D08/D09 interfaces, followed by affected requalification.
parallel_work: Disjoint Luna helpers inventory each contract family, case membership, expected fields and provenance; financial experts own semantics.
Independent expectation authors and implementation authors stay separate.
sprints.deliverable: Generic language/library implementation of all retained ACTUS cases, exact event schedules and financial observations; reconcile fixture membership without shrinking the corpus.

proposed_paths_or_roles: ACTUS library/examples and fixture adapters under existing source/test conventions; no per-fixture compiler branches.
interfaces: Contract terms -> schedule/events -> exact financial state
Case identity -> every present expected field
Library semantic input -> affected successor qualification
ownership.shared_owner: One integrator owns shared IR, ABI, module exports, CLI dispatch and Cargo configuration; exact disjoint leaf write sets assigned before implementation.

features.status: draft implementation clause; not new acceptance milestone
features.ears: WHEN ACTUS membership is reported, the report SHALL identify all retained cases with their frozen source provenance.
features.positive: The276 contract cases and AD0 are accounted for in the277 aggregate.
features.refusal: The ANN32/31 discrepancy remains open until its exact members are reconciled.

features.status: draft implementation clause; not new acceptance milestone
features.ears: WHEN a fixture is compared, the consumer SHALL compare every specified field and its presence at each ordered event.
features.positive: Accrued interest, dates, rates, principal and payoff match where present.
features.refusal: Dropping a nonstandard field or substituting a nine-field blanket comparison fails.

features.status: draft implementation clause; not new acceptance milestone
features.ears: WHEN an ACTUS type is admitted, its library SHALL implement the declared schedule and numeric convention through general language constructs.
features.positive: PAM, ANN and NAM examples share ordinary compiler primitives.
features.refusal: A fixture-specific target circuit cannot count as language conformance.

features.status: draft implementation clause; not new acceptance milestone
features.ears: WHEN debt changes through capitalization or partial payment, the library SHALL preserve complete debt accounting.
features.positive: Opening, accrued, discharged and closing debt reconcile with interest-first allocation.
features.refusal: Discarded residual debt or absent-versus-zero confusion fails the oracle.

features.status: draft implementation clause; not new acceptance milestone
features.ears: WHEN a financial semantic input is accepted, its affected successor obligations SHALL be identified before native qualification.
features.positive: An accepted ANN rule is included in its relevant U4 input set.
features.refusal: A later library extension cannot inherit unaffected-scope certification automatically.

features.status: draft implementation clause; not new acceptance milestone
features.ears: WHEN ACTUS completion is claimed, the evidence SHALL retain all18 executable types,32taxonomy dispositions and DS01–07.
features.positive: Every retained row has its required source and execution disposition.
features.refusal: A representative sample or merged denominator cannot close U6.

exit_evidence: All277 aggregate members,18 executable types,32taxonomy dispositions and DS01–07; every present expected field and event ordering.
ANN32 requirement versus31 inventory discrepancy resolved against frozen acquisition/source identities, retaining AD0 and full scope.
external_blockers: Aggregate276 contract+AD0=277 is known; exact ANN membership remains unreconciled.
No complete filename-qualified277 manifest was found by Luna; reconcile before claiming membership.

sprints.title: DeFi, Capacity Exchange and clearing
deps: Prepare semantic/oracle inputs beside D02/D10; relevant accepted SP08 inputs precede D08 successor scope.

Separate expert owners handle clearing, lending, async and Capacity Exchange with shared arithmetic integration.
sprints.deliverable: Complete retained DeFi programs and libraries including fee capability, Capacity Exchange, uniform-price clearing, bounded solvers, oracle/liquidation and asynchronous recovery.

ownership.shared_owner: One integrator owns shared IR, ABI, module exports, CLI dispatch and Cargo configuration; exact disjoint leaf write sets assigned before implementation.

features.status: draft implementation clause; not new acceptance milestone
features.ears: WHEN DeFi coverage is reported, it SHALL retain each adopted row, supplement and case identity separately.
features.positive: All72rows and DA01–24 retain their own dispositions and overlaps.
features.refusal: A sample or combined historical test denominator cannot close conformance.

features.status: draft implementation clause; not new acceptance milestone
features.ears: WHEN a clearing program computes transfers, it SHALL preserve the reviewed exact clearing-price relation before rounding.
features.positive: The independent uniform-price case reconciles exact price and permitted rounded amounts.
features.refusal: An incorrect exact price cannot pass because rounded outputs happen to match.

features.status: draft implementation clause; not new acceptance milestone
features.ears: WHEN a netted settlement executes, its observation SHALL retain gross debits, fees and net outcomes.
features.positive: A batch preserves each gross obligation while producing the expected net transfer.
features.refusal: Net equality alone cannot conceal an unauthorized gross debit under Opus-owned scenarios.

features.status: draft implementation clause; not new acceptance milestone
features.ears: WHEN liquidation uses an oracle value, its consumer SHALL enforce the reviewed freshness and identity policy.
features.positive: A qualified fresh observation drives the expected liquidation accounting.
features.refusal: A stale or mismatched observation is refused under Opus-owned scenarios.

features.status: draft implementation clause; not new acceptance milestone
features.ears: WHEN Capacity Exchange or fee capability is used, the program SHALL preserve the declared service and recovery accounting.
features.positive: Capacity purchase, fees and reserved recovery reconcile across success and failure.
features.refusal: A missing reserve or unpaid service result cannot be reported settled.

features.status: draft implementation clause; not new acceptance milestone
features.ears: WHEN held-out and regression results are published, the report SHALL preserve membership, independence and complete observations.
features.positive: NAM19/refinance/pending redemption and eight intent/regression families receive their applicable evidence.
features.refusal: An exposed held-out is labeled exposed and cannot retain a fresh holdout claim.

exit_evidence: 72rows,DA01–24,TX01–12,VX01–06,24modern cases,12report products,three held-outs,eight intents and eight regression classes retained.
Independent source/runtime/native/target columns; held-out contamination disclosed and replaced without dropping original scope.
external_blockers: Supplement memberships lack a single complete fixture manifest; source identities need reconciliation.
Target custody, oracle freshness and multiparty authorization depend on Opus decisions and actual adapters.

features.status: draft implementation clause; not new acceptance milestone

features.positive: Two builders reproduce the claimed artifact and relation/key identities under stated conditions.
features.refusal: Randomized proof bytes are not falsely required to be byte-identical.

features.status: draft implementation clause; not new acceptance milestone
features.ears: WHEN release scope is reported, it SHALL distinguish source delivery, captured historical results, current checks and target qualification.
features.positive: Each required row names actual evidence and its candidate.

features.status: draft implementation clause; not new acceptance milestone

reading_bounds: Synthesis of all nine proposals plus five Luna reports. Selected source excerpts were revisited for public paths, UIREQ headings, Sherlock plan and A-machine P1–P6. Review output was bounded and some long sections truncated; this is not an exhaustive independent source/security audit. All ten online research outputs have now returned according to Root; their integration belongs to Root and they are not treated as read or validated by this synthesis.
publication: Only SPRINTS.json and ROADMAP-DRAFT.md are newly written in this task directory. No production/docs/checks/tests/builds/models/native/network actions were performed for this synthesis.
local_ci: All CI is local. Proposed scripts/sherlock-qa.sh invokes Python standard-library QA against actual existing source/fixture/observation formats; GitHub carries source PRs and resulting evidence only, with no GitHub Actions cost. This is a small QA entry point, not a scheduler, authority service or replacement orchestration platform.
